text:
sophia_sales: Hey team — FinHealth LATAM asking for a POC. Requirements: EU + Brazil only, BYO-KMS (customer-managed keys), strict IP whitelist for egress, and a pricing ballpark for dedicated capacity + expected monthly egress. Also want latency SLO (95th <100ms) for API calls from BR and DE. Can presales + infra confirm feasibility and ops cost?

arnold_presales: +1. We should confirm region availability for dedicated pools in São Paulo (sa-east-1) and Frankfurt (eu-central-1). Do we currently expose a Brazil subprocessor list?

tina_infra: We have Dedicated capacity in eu-central and a partner coloc in sao-paulo via partner X. For dedicated we can pin GPUs in both regions. Note: our Brazil deployment routes through partner's infra — need subproc disclosure.

miguel_security: From security side: BYO-KMS is fine if they provide an external KMS endpoint and we can egress only to it. Need the exact KMS hostname/IPs and whether they expect mutual TLS. Also need their SOC2+ISO attestation to add to the subproc list.

ken_ops: For IP whitelist we can limit outbound egress to a set of NAT IPs per region. Example CIDRs we can offer (subject to change):

```
GRK-EU-NAT: 18.197.32.0/24
GRK-BR-NAT: 34.210.128.0/26
```

We can reserve static egress IPs for the POC but it adds a carry charge on top of dedicated compute. Estimate: $500/mo per reserved IP block.

arnold_presales: Great, can you confirm whether the egress path to their BYO-KMS will remain within region (i.e., BR->BR, EU->EU) or if we fallback to cross-region if partner node is down? Customer insists on no cross-border key transport unless explicitly approved.

tina_infra: Default fallback today routes to regional standby in the same geography, but if both local nodes fail we have a global fallback that could cross regions. We can implement a strict routing policy for this tenant to disable global fallback — requires ops approval and will increase failover RTO.

miguel_security: If we disable global fallback, we need a signed exception in the contract (legal) and documented risk acceptance. @maria_legal can you chime in?

maria_legal: Yep — we can draft a routing exception clause. Will require customer sign-off acknowledging increased outage risk and acceptance of liability cap adjustments. Also we need subprocessor addendum listing partner X and any cloud providers used.

arnold_presales: Pricing ask from customer: upfront POC for 4 weeks + expected monthly for dedicated: they asked for a conservative number to build their budget. Any roughs?

ken_ops: Rough POC uplift: $12k for a 4-week dedicated pilot (includes reserved GPUs, management, reserved egress IPs). Ongoing monthly for the minimal dedicated slice we recommend: $11k/mo + egress (metered). Egress pricing: $0.09/GB in BR, $0.03/GB in EU. These are estimates until we confirm partner costs.

sophia_sales: Helpful — can you split the $11k into compute vs networking so finance can line-item?

ken_ops: Compute: ~$8k/mo (reserved GPUs + support), Network & reserved IPs: ~$2k/mo, Ops overhead/SLAs: ~$1k/mo. If they require strict no-global-fallback routing add a one-time hardening fee of $3k.

miguel_security: For the security questionnaire: we need the customer's KMS endpoint pattern, whether they require HSM-backed keys, and their required cipher suites. Also confirm if they want us to store any encryption material at rest.

arnold_presales: I'll ask the customer for KMS hostname, HSM requirement, and an initial risk acceptance doc.

deploy-bot: Deployment ticket created: D-19821 — presales/poc: finhealth-latam, regions [eu-central-1, sa-east-1], BYO-KMS, reserved-egress-ip, strict-routing-flag=false (ops to update).

tina_infra: Note — if ops set strict-routing-flag=true we need 72h lead time to coordinate partner routing and update firewall rules.

sophia_sales: Thanks all. Action items: Arnold to request KMS details + security checklist from customer; Ken to produce a 1‑page cost breakout and formal POC quote; Maria to prepare routing exception draft if needed; Tina/Ken to confirm exact CIDRs and lead times. Will sync again once we have KMS endpoint. :thumbsup:

arnold_presales: On it. Ping me if legal needs a template.

maria_legal: I have a template for routing exceptions — will attach in the next message (or DM).

ken_ops: I'll add the reserved-IP SKU and one-time hardening line in the quote.

sophia_sales: closing loop — will update customer after Arnold's ask. Thanks! :pray:
